blocks.title: Shipping from Dubai to Kenya - Your Complete Guide
blocks.body: The United Arab Emirates, particularly Dubai, is one of East Africa's most important trade partners. With Jebel Ali Port as a global re-export hub, UAE offers competitive pricing, flexible order quantities, and faster transit times than many other origins. Kenya Tradex provides end-to-end shipping solutions from UAE ports and airports to Mombasa.
paragraphs: Sea freight from Jebel Ali to Mombasa is commonly planned around 7 to 12 days. Air freight from Dubai to Kenya can move faster, often around 1 to 2 days, but the full delivery timeline also depends on cargo readiness, vessel cut-off, customs clearance, release and final delivery after arrival.
Also shipping from other origins? See our shipping from China , our Jebel Ali to Mombasa transit time guide , or vehicle import services .
items: Ocean Freight (FCL/LCL): Full container (20ft/40ft) or shared container options from Jebel Ali and other UAE ports.
Air Freight: Fast delivery from Dubai International Airport (DXB) and Sharjah International Airport.
Customs Clearance: Full KRA customs processing at Mombasa port or JKIA airport.
Door-to-Door Delivery: Transport from Mombasa port to your warehouse or business location.
Transit Bonds: For cargo continuing to Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, DRC, or South Sudan.
Cargo Insurance: Optional coverage for your shipment during transit.

blocks.title: Why Import from UAE?
items: Short Transit Time: Just 7-12 days sea freight from Jebel Ali to Mombasa - faster than China or India routes.
Re-Export Hub: Dubai's position as a global re-export center means access to goods from around the world with flexible minimum orders.
No Language Barriers: English widely spoken in UAE business transactions.
Established Trade Routes: Long-standing shipping relationships between UAE and East Africa.
Quality Suppliers: Established markets and verified suppliers in textiles, electronics, machinery, and consumer goods.

blocks.title: Major UAE Ports and Airports We Ship From
blocks.body: Route-specific planning: if you are comparing Jebel Ali to Mombasa sea transit time , our transit time guide covers sailing windows, LCL vs FCL timing and what usually adds extra days after vessel arrival. Read the Jebel Ali transit time guide .
items: Jebel Ali Port (Dubai): The Middle East's largest container port, frequent sailings to Mombasa, competitive rates.
Port of Khalid (Sharjah): Alternative port with good connections to East Africa.
Dubai International Airport (DXB): Major air cargo hub with daily flights to Nairobi (NBO).
Sharjah International Airport: Cost-effective air freight option with regular cargo flights.

blocks.title: Common Products Imported from UAE to Kenya
items: Textiles & Fabrics: Garments, textiles, and fashion accessories from Dubai's established textile markets.
Electronics: Smartphones, computers, TVs, and consumer electronics re-exported through UAE.
Machinery: Industrial equipment, agricultural machinery, and construction tools.
Plastics & Chemicals: Raw materials for Kenyan manufacturing and processing industries.
Building Materials: Steel, aluminum, plumbing supplies, and construction equipment.
Vehicle Parts: Spare parts for cars, trucks, and heavy equipment.
Consumer Goods: Household items, cosmetics, and retail products.

blocks.title: How shipping from Dubai to Kenya works
items: Step 1: Share your cargo details including type, volume, origin (Dubai/Sharjah/Abu Dhabi), and destination in Kenya.
Step 2: We provide shipping quotes and book space with our carrier partners for the Jebel Ali to Mombasa route.
Step 3: Cargo is picked up from your supplier or consolidated at the UAE port.
Step 4: Shipment departs for Mombasa port (7-12 days sea, 1-2 days air).
Step 5: We handle customs clearance with KRA upon arrival at Mombasa.
Step 6: Cargo delivered to your warehouse or final destination.

blocks.title: Shipping from Dubai questions
items:
How long does shipping from Dubai to Kenya take? 
Ocean freight from Dubai (Jebel Ali) to Mombasa takes 7-12 days. Air freight is faster at 1-2 days. Kenya Tradex handles the entire process from pickup in UAE to delivery in Kenya.

What UAE ports do you ship from? 
We ship from Jebel Ali Port (Dubai's main container hub), Port of Khalid (Sharjah), and Abu Dhabi ports. For air freight, we work with Dubai International Airport (DXB) and Sharjah International Airport.

How much does shipping from Dubai to Kenya cost? 
Shipping costs from Dubai to Kenya are highly competitive. Contact Kenya Tradex for an accurate quote based on your cargo type, volume, and preferred shipping method. We provide transparent, all-inclusive pricing.

What products are commonly imported from UAE to Kenya? 
Common imports from UAE include textiles, machinery, electronics, re-export goods, plastics, chemicals, building materials, vehicle parts, and consumer goods. Dubai's position as a re-export hub means many goods are available with flexible minimum order quantities.
